title: Materialize real current-host provider admission and executable evidence path for Hugging Face cache, LM Studio and Ollama
decisions: The first provider production smoke uses only artifacts already present on the workstation.
Hugging Face evidence proves a real immutable cached snapshot and content hash without network access.
LM Studio evidence must discover a local LLM, explicitly load it with GPU offload disabled, execute a real one-shot inference and unload the test instance.
Ollama evidence must use an isolated loopback server with accelerators hidden, execute a real local model generation and prove size_vram equals zero.
No model download, pull or floating remote admission is allowed in the smoke workflow.
GPU provider evidence remains a separate follow-up and requires Host Resource Broker admission or lease evidence.
